review.notes: Full re-review. All 12 findings of the previous review are repaired. New findings: AutomorphicSpectralTheory §§0.26–0.28 already owns the positive-axis Whittaker M and W (P2); joint holomorphy of 𝐌 in (a,b,z) is used but unowned, since SpecialFunctionsParabolicCylinder §1.5 gives only separate holomorphy (P2); 13.6.18 and 13.18.14–16 are false for Re z<0 and 13.6.14–15 are narrowed (P2); 9.4 states 13.24–13.26 with no hypotheses (P2); the corrected 13.9.3/13.9.6 counts are statable but absent from Suggested.lean (P2); plus 3 P3s (Checks, Beyond-section owners and wording, 1.1/1.3 build order). Gate re-run with --base origin/main: every text and Lean check 0; depcheck reports only 'NOT IN ORDER' (not a finding before intake); depcheck against the candidate order: 236 roadmaps, 2262 edges, 0 problems. Lean: 37 sorry warnings, no errors; #check @name of all 50 declarations elaborates; the one-tactic probe closes 0 of 37. Source sample: all 15 seeded targets checked against DLMF Release 1.2.8 (§§13.2, 13.3, 13.6, 13.8, 13.9, 13.12, 13.14, 13.15, 13.18, 13.20, 13.22, 13.24–13.26 fetched; §§13.4 and 13.7 read on the public DLMF pages). Adversarial table: every Lean statement plus sampled and finding-touched statements, computed in pure Python. Citations resolved on main (AsymptoticExpansions, SpecialFunctionsParabolicCylinder, SpecialFunctionsEiLiErfIncompleteGamma) and at the open heads (QuantumFoundations, LaguerreJacobi, SpecialFunctionsBessel, SpecialFunctionsAiry, AutomorphicSpectralTheory, SpecialFunctionsHypergeometric).
